description: We are Lartex, a team passionate about gaming, technology, and space exploration. We aim to create an innovative project for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We welcome creative and motivated teammates interested in coding, game development, AI, design, and space. Let's learn, innovate, and build something amazing together!
summary: Project Stellar 08 is a 3D space game in which you launch Pip, a robot probe, from Earth, fly it to real asteroids and a real exoplanet from NASA data, scan their surfaces, and send the science home through a ground link.
details: Project Stellar 08 is a browser game that turns real NASA data into missions. Each of the three missions is built from actual records: the asteroid that passed closest to Earth in the latest NASA near-Earth object feed (Flyby), the largest other nearby asteroid in the same feed (Rendezvous), and a real exoplanet from the NASA Exoplanet Archive near the middle of the catalogue's distances (Exoplanet survey). Before launch, Pip shares the real facts about the target in its briefing, and the real values are shown exactly.
dataRefs: NASA NeoWs (Near Earth Object Web Service)
